<summary>Analysis steps, methods and full verification</summary>

## Tasks

Read, validate and prepare archived KO/pathway matrices, carrier contributions, the fixed Figure 3 feature list, defense/anti-defense sets and NARP locus evidence for Figure 3, Supplementary Figure 3 and Data 1. No annotation, structure prediction, coverage estimation or database search is rerun.

### Task 1: Inputs

```{r}
#| label: inputs
manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "input-manifest.tsv"))
raw_manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "raw-input-manifest.tsv"))
defs <- rwv_definitions_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/definitions.tsv", manifest))
style <- rwv_style_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/style.yml", manifest))
samples <- rwv_samples_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/samples.tsv", manifest), style)
raw <- function(f) as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_raw_input(step, path_data, f, raw_manifest)))
raw_path <- function(f) rwv_raw_input(step, path_data, f, raw_manifest)
up <- function(f) as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "020-community-analysis", f)))
hosts <- up("host_iphop.tsv")
catalogue <- up("checkv_catalogue.tsv")
checks <- rwv_checks_new()
num <- as.numeric
smp <- rwv_sample_levels(samples)   # configured order; source tables are reordered to it
```

### Task 2: KO and pathway matrices

Matrix values are summed TPM of vOTUs carrying a KO or pathway, not expression or metabolic flux.

```{r}
#| label: matrices
ko <- raw("amg_ko_matrix_tpm.tsv")
for (k in c(smp, "total_TPM", "samples_detected")) ko[[k]] <- num(ko[[k]])
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "amg_ko", nrow(ko), "amg_ko_matrix_tpm.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "KO total_TPM equals the row sum", ko$total_TPM, rowSums(ko[, smp]), tol = 1e-6)
rwv_check(checks, "samples_detected equals positive cells", ko$samples_detected, rowSums(ko[, smp] > 0))
pw <- raw("amg_pathway_matrix_tpm.tsv")
for (k in c(smp, "total_TPM", "samples_detected")) pw[[k]] <- num(pw[[k]])
rwv_check(checks, "curated pathway rows", 68, nrow(pw))
rwv_check(checks, "pathway total_TPM equals row sum", pw$total_TPM, rowSums(pw[, smp]), tol = 1e-6)
rwv_write_tsv(ko[, c("dbid", "db_desc", smp, "total_TPM", "samples_detected")], path_target("amg_ko_matrix.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(pw[, c("canonical_pathway_id", "canonical_pathway_name", "canonical_pathway_top_category", smp,
                     "total_TPM", "samples_detected")], path_target("amg_pathway_matrix.tsv"))
```

### Task 3: KO-level carrier contributions

```{r}
#| label: carriers
con <- raw("amg_carrier_contributions.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "amg_carriers_dbid", length(unique(con$vOTU_id[con$feature_level == "dbID"])),
              "amg_carrier_contributions.tsv (dbID level)")
kc <- con[con$feature_level == "KO", c("feature_id", "feature_name", "vOTU_id", smp, "votu_total_TPM", "feature_total_TPM",
                                       "contribution_fraction", "driver_rank")]
for (k in c(smp, "votu_total_TPM", "feature_total_TPM", "contribution_fraction", "driver_rank")) kc[[k]] <- num(kc[[k]])
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "amg_carriers_ko", length(unique(kc$vOTU_id)), "amg_carrier_contributions.tsv (KO level)")
rwv_check(checks, "KO-level contribution rows", 731, nrow(kc))
rwv_check(checks, "every KO row has carriers", sort(ko$dbid), sort(unique(kc$feature_id)))
sum_by_ko <- tapply(kc$votu_total_TPM, kc$feature_id, sum)[ko$dbid]
rwv_check(checks, "carrier TPM sums reproduce the KO matrix totals", ko$total_TPM, unname(sum_by_ko), tol = 1e-6)
for (s in smp) {
  rwv_check(checks, paste("carrier TPM sums reproduce KO matrix column", s), ko[[s]], unname(tapply(kc[[s]], kc$feature_id, sum)[ko$dbid]), tol = 1e-6)
}
rwv_check(checks, "contribution fractions sum to 1 per KO", rep(1, nrow(ko)), unname(tapply(kc$contribution_fraction, kc$feature_id, sum)[ko$dbid]), tol = 1e-9)
summ <- raw("amg_feature_driver_summary.tsv")
summ <- summ[summ$feature_level == "KO", ]
rwv_check(checks, "carriers per KO equal saved n_contributing_vOTU", num(summ$n_contributing_vOTU),
          as.numeric(table(kc$feature_id)[summ$feature_id]))
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "k00558_carriers", sum(kc$feature_id == "K00558"), "amg_carrier_contributions.tsv")
kc <- kc[order(kc$feature_id, kc$driver_rank), ]
rwv_write_tsv(kc, path_target("amg_ko_carriers.tsv"))

# The same contribution table is also resolved at two other feature levels.
# Both are carried through so that the 560 (dbID) and 544 (KO) carrier
# definitions can be rebuilt member by member, and so that the pathway matrix
# has the carrier rows behind it.
cols <- c("feature_id", "feature_name", "vOTU_id", smp, "votu_total_TPM", "feature_total_TPM",
          "contribution_fraction", "driver_rank")
lvl_out <- list(curated_pathway = "amg_pathway_carriers.tsv", dbID = "amg_dbid_carriers.tsv")
for (lv in names(lvl_out)) {
  x <- con[con$feature_level == lv, cols]
  for (k in c(smp, "votu_total_TPM", "feature_total_TPM", "contribution_fraction", "driver_rank")) x[[k]] <- num(x[[k]])
  x <- x[order(x$feature_id, x$driver_rank), ]
  rwv_check(checks, paste0(lv, "-level contribution rows"), c(curated_pathway = 934, dbID = 772)[[lv]], nrow(x),
            source = "amg_carrier_contributions.tsv")
  rwv_check(checks, paste0(lv, "-level contribution fractions sum to 1 per feature"),
            rep(1, length(unique(x$feature_id))), unname(tapply(x$contribution_fraction, x$feature_id, sum)), tol = 1e-9)
  rwv_write_tsv(x, path_target(lvl_out[[lv]]))
}
pwc <- con[con$feature_level == "curated_pathway", ]
for (k in c(smp, "votu_total_TPM")) pwc[[k]] <- num(pwc[[k]])
rwv_check(checks, "pathway carriers cover exactly the pathways of the pathway matrix",
          sort(pw$canonical_pathway_id), sort(unique(pwc$feature_id)))
rwv_check(checks, "carrier TPM sums reproduce the pathway matrix totals", pw$total_TPM,
          unname(tapply(pwc$votu_total_TPM, pwc$feature_id, sum)[pw$canonical_pathway_id]), tol = 1e-6)
for (s in smp) {
  rwv_check(checks, paste("carrier TPM sums reproduce pathway matrix column", s), pw[[s]],
            unname(tapply(pwc[[s]], pwc$feature_id, sum)[pw$canonical_pathway_id]), tol = 1e-6)
}
dbc <- con[con$feature_level == "dbID", ]
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "amg_carriers_dbid", length(unique(dbc$vOTU_id)), "amg_dbid_carriers.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "amg_carriers_ko", length(unique(kc$vOTU_id)), "amg_ko_carriers.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "every KO-level carrier is also a dbID-level carrier", TRUE,
          all(unique(kc$vOTU_id) %in% unique(dbc$vOTU_id)))
extra <- setdiff(unique(dbc$vOTU_id), unique(kc$vOTU_id))
rwv_check(checks, "dbID carriers minus KO carriers", rwv_def(defs, "amg_carriers_dbid") - rwv_def(defs, "amg_carriers_ko"),
          length(extra), source = "definitions.tsv amg_carriers_dbid and amg_carriers_ko")
rwv_write_tsv(data.frame(vOTU_id = sort(extra),
                         note = "carries an AMG dbID entry that is not one of the 138 KOs, so it is in the 560 but not in the 544"),
              path_target("amg_dbid_only_carriers.tsv"))
```

### Task 4: Verify the fixed 11-row Figure 3 list

The fixed display rule is the ten KOs with highest archived total_TPM, ties ordered by KO identifier, plus the prespecified NARP example K13522. This task verifies the list and source hashes without selecting a new list.

```{r}
#| label: selection
sel <- raw("f3_display_selection.tsv")
prov <- jsonlite::read_json(raw_path("f3_display_selection_provenance.json"))
ko_sha <- raw_manifest$origin_sha256[basename(raw_manifest$path) == "amg_ko_matrix_tpm.tsv"]
drv_sha <- raw_manifest$origin_sha256[basename(raw_manifest$path) == "amg_feature_driver_summary.tsv"]
rwv_check(checks, "selection provenance hash of the KO matrix equals the staged source", prov$source_sha256[["workspace/codex_work/results/amg_pathway_current/amg_ko_matrix_tpm.tsv"]], ko_sha)
rwv_check(checks, "selection provenance hash of the driver summary equals the staged source", prov$source_sha256[["workspace/codex_work/results/amg_votu_host_drivers/amg_feature_driver_summary.tsv"]], drv_sha)
ord <- ko[order(-ko$total_TPM, ko$dbid), ]
frozen <- c("K00558", "K13381", "K00820", "K01939", "K00560", "K01858", "K00390", "K13010", "K06217", "K03462", "K13522")
rwv_check(checks, "top 10 by total_TPM (ties by KO) + K13522 equals the frozen list", frozen, c(head(ord$dbid, 10), "K13522"))
rwv_check(checks, "selection file order equals the frozen list", frozen, sel$KO[order(num(sel$display_order))])
rwv_check(checks, "saved selection totals equal the KO matrix", ko$total_TPM[match(frozen, ko$dbid)],
          num(sel$total_TPM_saved[match(frozen, sel$KO)]), tol = 1e-6)
rwv_check(checks, "K13522 is not in the top 10", TRUE, !"K13522" %in% head(ord$dbid, 10))
short <- function(x) trimws(sub(";.*$", "", sub("\\s*\\[.*$", "", x)))
disp <- data.frame(KO = frozen, display_order = seq_along(frozen),
                   selection = ifelse(frozen == "K13522", "prespecified NARP case (not top 10)", "top 10 by total carrier TPM"),
                   label_full = sel$display_label_source[match(frozen, sel$KO)],
                   gene = short(sub("^K13522, ", "", sel$display_label_source[match(frozen, sel$KO)])),
                   total_TPM = ko$total_TPM[match(frozen, ko$dbid)], rank_total_TPM = match(frozen, ord$dbid),
                   n_carriers = as.numeric(table(kc$feature_id)[frozen]))
for (s in smp) disp[[s]] <- ko[[s]][match(frozen, ko$dbid)]
rank_rows <- list()
for (k in frozen) {
  r <- kc[kc$feature_id == k, ]
  r <- r[order(r$driver_rank), ]
  f <- r$contribution_fraction
  ids <- r$vOTU_id
  rank_rows[[k]] <- data.frame(KO = k, rank_class = c("Top 1", "Top 2", "Top 3", "Other carriers"),
                               fraction = c(f[1], ifelse(length(f) >= 2, f[2], 0), ifelse(length(f) >= 3, f[3], 0),
                                            if (length(f) > 3) sum(f[-(1:3)]) else 0),
                               vOTU_id = c(ids[1], if (length(ids) >= 2) ids[2] else NA, if (length(ids) >= 3) ids[3] else NA,
                                           if (length(ids) > 3) sprintf("%d others", length(ids) - 3) else NA))
}
ranks <- do.call(rbind, rank_rows)
rwv_check(checks, "rank fractions sum to 1 per displayed KO", rep(1, 11), unname(tapply(ranks$fraction, ranks$KO, sum)[frozen]), tol = 1e-9)
rwv_check(checks, "top-1 fraction equals the saved selection value", num(sel$top1_fraction_saved[match(frozen, sel$KO)]),
          ranks$fraction[ranks$rank_class == "Top 1"], tol = 1e-9)
rwv_check(checks, "top-1 vOTU equals the saved dominant vOTU", sel$dominant_vOTU_saved[match(frozen, sel$KO)],
          ranks$vOTU_id[ranks$rank_class == "Top 1"])
rwv_write_tsv(disp, path_target("f3_display.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(ranks, path_target("f3_carrier_ranks.tsv"))
knitr::kable(disp[, c("KO", "gene", "selection", "total_TPM", "rank_total_TPM", "n_carriers")], digits = 0)
```

### Task 5: Display-KO carriers and verified host records

Host links use only the 200 verified iPHoP score >= 90 records from 020; historical host fields in the driver table are not used.

```{r}
#| label: carrier-hosts
sub_kc <- kc[kc$feature_id %in% frozen, c("feature_id", "vOTU_id", "driver_rank", "contribution_fraction")]
m <- match(sub_kc$vOTU_id, hosts$vOTU_id)
sub_kc$iphop90_status <- ifelse(is.na(m), "no iPHoP >= 90 record", hosts$visibility_status[m])
sub_kc$host_genus <- ifelse(is.na(m), NA, hosts$host_genus_clean[m])
rwv_write_tsv(sub_kc, path_target("f3_carrier_hosts.tsv"))
knitr::kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(sub_kc$feature_id, sub_kc$iphop90_status))[frozen, , drop = FALSE])
```

### Task 5b: Complete KO-carrier host evidence and selected co-detected pathways

Descriptive joins use current 020 host records and co-detection details. The full table retains all KO carriers, including missing predictions, unresolved genera and absence of co-detection. The pathway table is the same-sample co-detected subset; it is not evidence of infection or host metabolic function.

```{r}
#| label: literature-host-links
lit_codetection <- up("host_codetection_by_sample.tsv")
lit_crispr <- up("host_crispr_edges.tsv")
literature_links <- rwv_literature_host_links(kc, hosts, lit_codetection, lit_crispr, samples)
lit_register <- literature_links$register
lit_paths <- literature_links$paths
rwv_check(checks, "AMG-host register covers every KO carrier exactly once", sort(unique(kc$vOTU_id)), lit_register$vOTU_id,
          source = "amg_ko_carriers.tsv (all carriers, not only successful host links)")
rwv_check(checks, "AMG-host evidence coverage: all / primary prediction / visible genus / co-detected", c(544L, 36L, 24L, 16L),
          c(nrow(lit_register), sum(lit_register$has_iphop90_record), sum(lit_register$host_in_16s, na.rm = TRUE), sum(lit_register$codetected)),
          source = "020 host_iphop.tsv and primary host_codetection_by_sample.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "selected KO-host paths: associations / KOs / vOTUs / genera", c(22L, 14L, 16L, 14L),
          c(nrow(lit_paths), length(unique(lit_paths$KO)), length(unique(lit_paths$vOTU_id)), length(unique(lit_paths$host_genus))),
          source = "all KO associations of the co-detected AMG-carrier subset")
rwv_check(checks, "every selected AMG-host association occurs in one actual sample", TRUE,
          all(lit_register$n_codetected_samples[lit_register$codetected] == 1L))
lit_case <- lit_register[lit_register$vOTU_id == "vOTU0052", , drop = FALSE]
rwv_check(checks, "NARP case: retained host genus / sample / confidence / strict CRISPR", c("g__Novosphingobium", "gd1", "90.8", "FALSE"),
          c(lit_case$host_genus_clean, lit_case$codetected_samples, as.character(lit_case$iphop_confidence), as.character(lit_case$strict_crispr_same_genus)),
          source = "020 primary iPHoP record, same-sample flags and strict CRISPR edges")
rwv_write_tsv(lit_register, path_target("amg_host_register.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(lit_paths, path_target("ko_carrier_host_paths.tsv"))
knitr::kable(data.frame(AMG_carriers = nrow(lit_register), highscore_host_records = sum(lit_register$has_iphop90_record),
                       host_genus_visible = sum(lit_register$host_in_16s, na.rm = TRUE), primary_host_codetected = sum(lit_register$codetected)))
```

### Task 6: Tool-specific defense and anti-defense sets

The prespecified OR-rule union is 722 = 106 DefenseFinder anti-defense + 715 filtered dbAPIS - 99 overlapping members. Counts from different tools are not added without accounting for overlap.

```{r}
#| label: defense
lv <- raw("local_votu_table.tsv")
for (k in c("df_Antidefense", "df_Defense", "n_dbapis", "n_padloc")) lv[[k]] <- num(lv[[k]])
rwv_check(checks, "local vOTU table covers the catalogue", sort(catalogue$vOTU_id), sort(lv$vOTU_id))
a <- lv$df_Antidefense > 0; b <- lv$n_dbapis > 0
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "df_antidefense", sum(a), "local_votu_table.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "dbapis_filtered", sum(b), "local_votu_table.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "antidefense_overlap", sum(a & b), "local_votu_table.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "antidefense_union", sum(a | b), "local_votu_table.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "df_defense", sum(lv$df_Defense > 0), "local_votu_table.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "padloc", sum(lv$n_padloc > 0), "local_votu_table.tsv")
tiers <- raw("cargo_library_tiers.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "tool counts equal cargo_library_tiers.tsv (dbAPIS, DF anti-defense, DF defense, PADLOC)",
          num(tiers$n_carrier_votu[1:4]), c(sum(b), sum(a), sum(lv$df_Defense > 0), sum(lv$n_padloc > 0)))
membership <- data.frame(vOTU_id = lv$vOTU_id, df_antidefense = as.integer(a), dbapis_filtered = as.integer(b),
                         antidefense_union = as.integer(a | b), df_defense = as.integer(lv$df_Defense > 0),
                         padloc = as.integer(lv$n_padloc > 0), genomad_n_genes = num(lv$genomad_n_genes))
rwv_write_tsv(membership, path_target("defense_membership.tsv"))
sets <- data.frame(
  set = c("DefenseFinder anti-defense", "filtered dbAPIS", "DefenseFinder anti-defense AND dbAPIS", "Anti-defense union (OR)",
          "DefenseFinder defense", "PADLOC defense"),
  tool = c("DefenseFinder", "dbAPIS (filtered)", "both", "DefenseFinder OR dbAPIS", "DefenseFinder", "PADLOC"),
  unit = "vOTUs with >= 1 call/hit", n = c(sum(a), sum(b), sum(a & b), sum(a | b), sum(lv$df_Defense > 0), sum(lv$n_padloc > 0)),
  denominator = nrow(lv))
rwv_write_tsv(sets, path_target("defense_sets.tsv"))
knitr::kable(sets)
```

### Task 7: NARP definitions and the vOTU0052 locus

```{r}
#| label: narp
nd <- raw("narp_votu_detail.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "narp1_df", sum(nd$subtype == "NARP1"), "narp_votu_detail.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "narp2_df", sum(nd$subtype == "NARP2"), "narp_votu_detail.tsv")
co <- raw("narp_ko_cooccurrence.tsv")
co_ids <- unique(co$vOTU_id)
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "narp_ko_cooccurrence", length(co_ids), "cooccurring_NAMPT_K03462_nadM_K13522_vOTUs.tsv")
ctx <- raw("narp_thoeris_context.tsv")
dbapis_narp <- strsplit(ctx$vOTUs[ctx$metric == "dbAPIS_NARP_targeting_vOTUs"], ";")[[1]]
rwv_check(checks, "saved dbAPIS NARP-targeting count equals its ID list", as.numeric(ctx$n[ctx$metric == "dbAPIS_NARP_targeting_vOTUs"]),
          length(dbapis_narp), source = "narp_thoeris_context.tsv (n column vs vOTUs column)")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "dbapis_narp_targeting", length(dbapis_narp), "narp_thoeris_context.tsv")
ids <- sort(unique(c(nd$vOTU_id, co_ids, dbapis_narp)))
rwv_check(checks, "vOTUs under any of the four NARP definitions", 19, length(ids),
          source = "regression constant: union of narp_votu_detail, KO co-occurrence and dbAPIS NARP-targeting sets")
narp_def <- data.frame(vOTU_id = ids,
                       df_narp1 = as.integer(ids %in% nd$vOTU_id[nd$subtype == "NARP1"]),
                       df_narp2 = as.integer(ids %in% nd$vOTU_id[nd$subtype == "NARP2"]),
                       ko_K03462_K13522 = as.integer(ids %in% co_ids),
                       dbapis_narp_targeting = as.integer(ids %in% dbapis_narp))
cm <- match(ids, catalogue$vOTU_id)
narp_def$checkv_quality <- catalogue$checkv_quality[cm]
narp_def$checkv_completeness_pct <- num(catalogue$checkv_completeness_pct[cm])
narp_def$length_bp <- num(catalogue$contig_length_bp[cm])
rwv_check(checks, "KO co-occurrence set minus DF NARP2 set", "vOTU0863", setdiff(co_ids, nd$vOTU_id[nd$subtype == "NARP2"]))
rwv_check(checks, "DF NARP2 set is inside the KO co-occurrence set", TRUE, all(nd$vOTU_id[nd$subtype == "NARP2"] %in% co_ids))
rwv_write_tsv(narp_def, path_target("narp_definitions.tsv"))
```

### Task 7b: NARP2-case abundance and DefenseFinder/PADLOC types

Extract the existing masked trimmed TPM and covered fraction from the 012 TSE for seven verified vOTUs across seven samples. Percentages use the entire sample-specific masked catalogue (1e6 TPM), without renormalizing the seven members, row scaling or new rarefaction. DefenseFinder/PADLOC type fields retain their source values with explanatory notes.

```{r}
#| label: narp-samples-types
tse <- readRDS(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "012-tse-construction", "tse_virome.rds"))
n2_ids <- narp_def$vOTU_id[narp_def$df_narp2 == 1]
k13522_ids <- sort(unique(sub_kc$vOTU_id[sub_kc$feature_id == "K13522"]))

ab_ids <- c("vOTU0052", setdiff(n2_ids, "vOTU0052"), extra_ids)
tt <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(tse, "trimmed_tpm")
cf <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(tse, "covered_fraction")
rwv_check(checks, "TSE samples cover the configured samples", TRUE, all(smp %in% colnames(tt)))
rwv_check(checks, "masked trimmed TPM sums to one million per sample (whole-catalogue denominator)", rep(1e6, length(smp)),
          unname(colSums(tt[, smp])), tol = 1e-3)
nm <- match(ab_ids, narp_def$vOTU_id)
ab <- data.frame(vOTU_id = rep(ab_ids, times = length(smp)), sample_id = rep(smp, each = length(ab_ids)))
ab$group <- ifelse(ab$vOTU_id %in% n2_ids, "DefenseFinder NARP2 call", "nadM (K13522) carrier without a NARP2 call")
ab$ko_rule_K03462_K13522 <- narp_def$ko_K03462_K13522[match(ab$vOTU_id, narp_def$vOTU_id)]

ab$covered_fraction <- cf[cbind(ab$vOTU_id, ab$sample_id)]
ab$detected <- ab$covered_fraction >= 0.75
ab$checkv_quality <- narp_def$checkv_quality[match(ab$vOTU_id, narp_def$vOTU_id)]
ab$checkv_completeness_pct <- narp_def$checkv_completeness_pct[match(ab$vOTU_id, narp_def$vOTU_id)]
ab$definition <- "masked trimmed TPM of the 012 TSE / 10,000 = percent of the whole breadth-masked catalogue in that sample; 0 where covered fraction < 0.75"
rwv_check(checks, "sample abundance table: 7 vOTUs x 7 samples, unique keys", c(49, 49), c(nrow(ab), nrow(unique(ab[, c("vOTU_id", "sample_id")]))))
rwv_check(checks, "non-zero abundance exactly where covered fraction >= 0.75", TRUE, identical(ab$trimmed_tpm_masked > 0, ab$detected))
rwv_check(checks, "non-zero vOTU-sample cells in the case set", 8L, sum(ab$detected),
          source = "regression constant (Codex-reviewed S2 candidate, 2026-10-14)")
rwv_write_tsv(ab, path_target("narp_carrier_sample_abundance.tsv"))

inv <- raw("defense_type_inventory.tsv")
qc <- c("Complete", "High-quality", "Medium-quality", "Low-quality", "Undetermined")
for (k in c("n_saved_records", "n_system_calls", "n_votu", qc)) inv[[k]] <- num(inv[[k]])
by_tool <- function(t, a) inv[inv$tool == t & inv$activity == a, ]
```

### Task 8: Document-reported case values with source line numbers

Coverage, HE-targeting and ORF102 domain values are available as tables or text in archived source documents rather than separate result files. Values are located and checked against those staged documents and exported with source line numbers. No analysis is repeated. Source-language search patterns are represented by equivalent Unicode escapes in the code.

```{r}
#| label: doc-values
# Values are read from the document table cells (not typed here). Where a
# second, independent source exists, the parsed value is compared with it;
# otherwise the check only records that the cell was found and parsed.
md_row <- function(file, key) {
  lines <- readLines(raw_path(file), encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
  plain <- gsub("\\*\\*|`", "", lines)
  hit <- which(startsWith(trimws(plain), "|") & grepl(key, plain, fixed = TRUE))
  if (length(hit) != 1L) rwv_fail("Expected one table row matching '", key, "' in ", file, ", found ", length(hit), ".")
  cells <- strsplit(sub("^\\s*\\|", "", sub("\\|\\s*$", "", lines[hit])), "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  list(line = hit, text = trimws(lines[hit]), cells = trimws(gsub("\\*\\*|`", "", cells)))
}
cell_num <- function(x) as.numeric(sub("[^0-9.]+$", "", sub("^[^0-9.]+", "", x)))
cell_range <- function(x, prefix = "") {
  m <- regmatches(x, regexec(paste0(prefix, "([0-9]+)[\u2013-]([0-9]+)"), x))[[1]]
  if (length(m) < 3) rwv_fail("No range found in '", x, "'.")
  as.numeric(m[2:3])
}
ev <- list()
add_ev <- function(group, item, value, unit, file, row, note, anchor = "document transcription; no independent source") {
  ev[[length(ev) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(group = group, item = item, value = value, unit = unit, source_file = file,
                                       source_line = row$line, source_text = row$text, note = note, independent_anchor = anchor)
}
cov_note <- paste("NARP2-locus depth divided by the contig median depth in the one sample with the most mapped reads selected for that contig (sample in source_text);",
                  "no replicate series is shown; the source document reports only one readable sample per contig, which is not re-checked here;",
                  "a relative ratio, not absolute 1x sequencing; a snapshot that cannot exclude amplification in a minority of the population or under induction")
cov_file <- "doc_votu0052_coverage_spike.md"
# Keys include the insertion-type cell so that only the result table matches
# (the document also lists the same contigs in a sample-selection table).
for (ct in list(c("vctg2997 | GIY-YIG HE", "vctg2997 (vOTU0052) NARP2 locus"),
                c("vctg3454 | HNH+NUMOD3", "vctg3454 NARP2 locus (HNH/NUMOD3 insertion)"),
                c("vctg2633 | \u975e HE \u63d2\u5165", "vctg2633 NARP2 locus (non-HE insertion)"),
                c("vctg2728 | \u65e0\u63d2\u5165", "vctg2728 NARP2 locus (no insertion)"),
                c("vctg2892 | \u65e0\u63d2\u5165", "vctg2892 NARP2 locus (no insertion)"))) {
  row <- md_row(cov_file, paste0("| ", ct[1]))
  add_ev("coverage", ct[2], cell_num(row$cells[5]), "relative depth (x contig median)", cov_file, row, cov_note)
}
he_file <- "doc_votu0052_he_targeting.md"
he_note <- "Genomes with >= 1 homing-endonuclease domain in the window among reference NARP2 carriers; observed vs null expectation"
strict <- md_row(he_file, "| \u5168\u90e8 | \u4e25\u683c（\u4e24\u57fa\u56e0\u4e4b\u95f4） |")
wide <- md_row(he_file, "| \u5168\u90e8 | ±10 ORF |")
add_ev("he_targeting", "strict site (between the two genes): assessable genomes", cell_num(strict$cells[3]), "genomes", he_file, strict, he_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "strict site (between the two genes): observed", cell_num(strict$cells[4]), "genomes", he_file, strict, he_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "strict site: expected", cell_num(strict$cells[5]), "genomes", he_file, strict, he_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "+-10 ORF window: assessable genomes", cell_num(wide$cells[3]), "genomes", he_file, wide, he_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "+-10 ORF window: observed", cell_num(wide$cells[4]), "genomes", he_file, wide, he_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "+-10 ORF window: expected", cell_num(wide$cells[5]), "genomes", he_file, wide, he_note)
# The Poisson p values of the same table rows, and the reference cohort the
# windows were evaluated in, as reported in the document (not re-tested here).
p_note <- "Reported one-sided Poisson enrichment p, P(X >= observed), of observed versus the conditional null (each genome's own homing-endonuclease count placed at random among its ORFs), as reported in the document; not re-tested"
add_ev("he_targeting", "strict site: reported one-sided Poisson enrichment p", cell_num(strict$cells[6]), "p", he_file, strict, p_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "+-10 ORF window: reported one-sided Poisson enrichment p", cell_num(wide$cells[6]), "p", he_file, wide, p_note)
he_lines <- readLines(raw_path(he_file), encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
he_line <- function(key) {
  hit <- grep(key, he_lines, fixed = TRUE)
  if (length(hit) != 1L) rwv_fail("Expected one line with '", key, "' in ", he_file, ", found ", length(hit), ".")
  list(line = hit, text = trimws(he_lines[hit]))
}
coh_all <- he_line("\u4e2a NAMPT \u9633\u6027\u566c\u83cc\u4f53\u57fa\u56e0\u7ec4")
coh_narp <- he_line("\u5e26\u672c\u5730 NMNAT")
adj <- he_line("\u76f8\u90bb\u65e0\u63d2\u5165")
first_num <- function(x, pat) as.numeric(gsub(",", "", regmatches(x, regexec(pat, x))[[1]][2]))
coh_note <- "INPHARED phage genomes from pc051e1-PhageNAMPT, ORFs called uniformly with pyrodigal; separate from the 77,951 genomes of Figure 5"
add_ev("he_targeting", "reference cohort: NAMPT-positive INPHARED genomes", first_num(coh_all$text, "([0-9,]+) \u4e2a NAMPT"), "genomes", he_file, coh_all, coh_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "reference cohort: genomes with NMNAT near NAMPT (NARP2 module)", first_num(coh_narp$text, "([0-9]+) \u4e2a\\*\\*\u5e26\u672c\u5730"), "genomes", he_file, coh_narp, coh_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "NARP2 modules with no ORF between the two genes", first_num(adj$text, "\u76f8\u90bb\u65e0\u63d2\u5165 ([0-9]+) \u4e2a"), "genomes", he_file, adj,
       "genomes whose strict window is empty and therefore not assessable")
rwv_check(checks, "HE: the +-10 ORF window covers the whole NARP2 reference cohort", cell_num(wide$cells[3]),
          first_num(coh_narp$text, "([0-9]+) \u4e2a\\*\\*\u5e26\u672c\u5730"), source = "doc_votu0052_he_targeting.md lines 27, 69")
rwv_check(checks, "HE: strict-window assessable = cohort minus modules with adjacent genes", cell_num(strict$cells[3]),
          cell_num(wide$cells[3]) - first_num(adj$text, "\u76f8\u90bb\u65e0\u63d2\u5165 ([0-9]+) \u4e2a"), source = "doc_votu0052_he_targeting.md lines 66, 69, 75")
# The rest of the same distribution of ORFs between the two NARP2 genes
# (2026-10-11 S2 addition): the reference baseline for how often the two genes
# are separated, and the reported power of the strict-window test.
ins_more <- he_line("\u9694 2–4 \u4e2a")
pow <- he_line("\u529f\u6548\u53ea\u6709")
dist_note <- "distribution of ORFs between NMNAT and NAMPT in the 104 reference NARP2 modules, as reported in the document; counts of genomes"
add_ev("he_targeting", "NARP2 modules with 1 ORF between the two genes", first_num(adj$text, "\u9694 1 \u4e2a ORF ([0-9]+) \u4e2a"), "genomes", he_file, adj, dist_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "NARP2 modules with 2-4 ORFs between the two genes", first_num(ins_more$text, "\u9694 2–4 \u4e2a ([0-9]+) \u4e2a"), "genomes", he_file, ins_more, dist_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "NARP2 modules with 6-9 ORFs between the two genes", first_num(ins_more$text, "\u9694 6–9 \u4e2a ([0-9]+) \u4e2a"), "genomes", he_file, ins_more, dist_note)
add_ev("he_targeting", "strict window: reported power to detect an odds ratio of 3 with 56 assessable genomes", first_num(pow$text, "\u529f\u6548\u53ea\u6709 ([0-9]+)%"), "percent", he_file, pow,
       "power curve reported in the document for the strict window; not re-computed")
n_between <- vapply(c("\u76f8\u90bb\u65e0\u63d2\u5165 ([0-9]+) \u4e2a", "\u9694 1 \u4e2a ORF ([0-9]+) \u4e2a"), function(p) first_num(adj$text, p), 0)
n_between <- c(n_between, first_num(ins_more$text, "\u9694 2–4 \u4e2a ([0-9]+) \u4e2a"), first_num(ins_more$text, "\u9694 6–9 \u4e2a ([0-9]+) \u4e2a"))
rwv_check(checks, "HE: the between-gene ORF distribution sums to the NARP2 reference cohort", cell_num(wide$cells[3]), sum(n_between),
          source = "doc_votu0052_he_targeting.md lines 69, 75-76")
rwv_check(checks, "HE: genomes with >= 1 ORF between the genes equal the strict-window assessable genomes", cell_num(strict$cells[3]), sum(n_between[-1]),
          source = "doc_votu0052_he_targeting.md lines 66, 75-76")
orf_file <- "doc_votu0052_orf102.md"
orf <- md_row(orf_file, "| ORF102 | 211 |")
dom_note <- "hmmscan against Pfam-A, reported in the project document; predictions, not evidence of cleavage activity"
giy <- cell_range(orf$cells[3], "GIY-YIG ")
numod <- cell_range(orf$cells[4])
env <- cell_range(orf$cells[4], "envelope ")
orf_len_coord <- locus$aa_length[locus$gene_position == "102"]
add_ev("orf102_domains", "ORF102 length", cell_num(orf$cells[2]), "aa", orf_file, orf, dom_note,
       anchor = sprintf("equals the length derived from the locus coordinates (%d aa)", orf_len_coord))
add_ev("orf102_domains", "GIY-YIG catalytic domain start", giy[1], "aa", orf_file, orf, dom_note)
add_ev("orf102_domains", "GIY-YIG catalytic domain end", giy[2], "aa", orf_file, orf, dom_note)
add_ev("orf102_domains", "I-HmuI NUMOD-like domain start", numod[1], "aa", orf_file, orf, dom_note)
add_ev("orf102_domains", "I-HmuI NUMOD-like domain end", numod[2], "aa", orf_file, orf, dom_note)

add_ev("orf102_domains", "NUMOD-like envelope end", env[2], "aa", orf_file, orf, dom_note)
si_lines <- readLines(raw_path("supplementary_information.qmd"), encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
# The amplicon rarefaction depths registered in definitions.tsv and quoted by
# the Figure 2 legend are stated in this document; 020 uses the registered
# value, this step checks the wording behind it.
rwv_check(checks, "supplementary information states the 16S and full-18S rarefaction depths", TRUE,
          any(grepl("63,564 reads for 16S and 53,257 for the full 18S dataset", si_lines, fixed = TRUE)),
          source = "supplementary_information.qmd")
rwv_check(checks, "supplementary information states that microeukaryote totals need not stay equal", TRUE,
          any(grepl("rarefied totals need not remain equal across samples", si_lines, fixed = TRUE)),
          source = "supplementary_information.qmd")
rwv_check(checks, "registered amplicon depths match that statement", "63564/53257",
          as.character(rwv_def(defs, "amplicon_rarefaction")), source = "definitions.tsv")
si_hit <- grep("NARP1 and NARP2 were called in", si_lines, fixed = TRUE)
if (length(si_hit) != 1L) rwv_fail("Expected one SI sentence with the global NARP counts.")
m <- as.numeric(regmatches(si_lines[si_hit], regexec("called in ([0-9]+) and ([0-9]+) genomes", si_lines[si_hit]))[[1]][2:3])
si_row <- list(line = si_hit, text = substr(trimws(si_lines[si_hit]), 1, 300))
glob_note <- "archived module-calling definition; separate from the fixed 38 non-NARP profiles; no joint call"
add_ev("global_narp", "global NARP1 module calls", m[1], "genomes (of 77,951)", "supplementary_information.qmd", si_row, glob_note,
       anchor = "equals the framework definition table (config/definitions.tsv: global_narp)")
add_ev("global_narp", "global NARP2 module calls", m[2], "genomes (of 77,951)", "supplementary_information.qmd", si_row, glob_note,
       anchor = "equals the framework definition table (config/definitions.tsv: global_narp)")
evidence <- do.call(rbind, ev)
rwv_check(checks, "every document value parsed to a number", FALSE, anyNA(evidence$value), source = "document tables")

          evidence$value[evidence$item == "ORF102 length"], source = "votu0052_context.tsv coordinates")

          paste(m, collapse = "/"), source = "config/definitions.tsv (framework table)")
rwv_check(checks, "GIY-YIG domain lies inside ORF102, before the NUMOD-like module", TRUE,
          giy[1] >= 1 && giy[2] < numod[1] && env[2] <= orf_len_coord && env[1] <= numod[1] && env[2] >= numod[2],
```
